name: model-router
description: Run Claude Code sessions, workers, and subagents on any model your subscriptions cover - one local proxy, zero API keys. Ships one build flow, /fabstra: Fable 5.2 orchestrates and never codes, Opus 5.5 orchestrates at 2+ independent tasks or an excluded category and leads below that, Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5 lead; Claude Opus 5.5 subagents build with effort pinned by tier, GPT-6 Astra or GPT-6.1 Sol (by the gate seat rubric) gates the plan, runs the Codex side spawning Sol / Terra / Luna / Spark, and reviews Claude-built work, and a fresh Fable 5.2 reviews Codex-built work. fabstra Lane B (1.6.1): "astra solo" - Astra designs and builds end to end from a Fable brief through the proxy, Sol xhigh and a fresh Fable both review, three must agree. 1.7.0: JC's fork - adds the fable-mode skill (the Fable Method for Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 / Haiku 4.5 sessions), ships the codex / codex-pro / proxy-key / proxy-pin shims in bin/, and replaces every machine-specific path with an env var (see SETUP.md). 1.8.0 (2026-09-07): the "astra fast" pin (codex-fast shim, Codex Fast mode on Pro-home launches only), the Pro-only spark agent (GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark mechanic on its own quota pool), headless Computer Use via codex/cua-headless.mjs, and a second-machine setup checklist in SETUP.md. 1.9.24-1.9.25 (2026-11-10): Fable 5.2 orchestrates, Claude Opus 5.5 build seats pin their effort by tier, a fresh Fable 5.2 reviews (xhigh on builds in an excluded category); README, SETUP and USE-CASES rewritten for the current crew. 1.9.28 (2026-11-15): Gemini review seats - Carbon reviews every real build's diff beside Phase 3 round 1 and checks research and audit reports before delivery; Hydrogen checks each code-changing fix round; their findings are leads the lead verifies, never a reviewer seat or a pass/fail. 1.9.29 (2026-11-15): geminipro ships here (scripts/geminipro.py, bin/geminipro shims, tests; set GEMINIPRO_ACCOUNT, see SETUP.md), shims also find scripts through MODEL_ROUTER_HOME, and scripts/gemini-hitrate.py reports how often Gemini review leads turn out real. 1.9.30 (2026-11-15): shared docs no longer name the maintainer's Pro account or subscription dates.
